decisive_items: a visible mass was noted in the right hypochondrium
Abdominal ultrasonography and contrast-enhanced CT scan of the abdomen were reported to be consistent with small-bowel intussusception
response.rationale: Intussusception is directly supported by imaging findings and clinical presentation, while gastrointestinal bleeding, although possible, is less directly supported and could be a consequence of intussusception

rejected.why: Inflammatory Bowel Disease is less directly supported by the specific findings of a visible mass and intussusception on imaging
Infectious enteritis is less specific and does not account for the mass or intussusception findings
